---
title: "make_table_for_supp1"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(glue)
library(readr)

pad_to_length <- function(x, n) {
  if (length(x) > n) stop("Vector longer than target length")
  c(x, rep(NA, n - length(x)))
}
```

```{r}
metrics <- c("degree", "betweenness_bin", "clustercoef_bin",
             "eigenvector_centrality_bin")
project_dir <- "~/Documents/repos/brain_connectivity_in_chronic_pain"

group_size <- 121  # max group length to pad each subgroup to

for (metric in metrics) {

  di <- list()

  for (i in 1:5) {

    file_path <- sprintf(glue("{project_dir}/Data/HDIs with metadata/HDIat0%d_w_meta_261004.csv"), i)
    per <- read_csv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

    # Intended filter: both conditions must hold
    per <- per %>%
      filter(time == 1 & passes_2mm_criterion == 1)

    hc <- per %>%
      filter(is_patient == 0) %>%
      pull(.data[[metric]])
    hc <- pad_to_length(hc, group_size)

    lomo <- per %>%
      filter(is_patient == 1, HiMo_subject == 0) %>%
      pull(.data[[metric]])
    lomo <- pad_to_length(lomo, group_size)

    himo <- per %>%
      filter(is_patient == 1, HiMo_subject == 1) %>%
      pull(.data[[metric]])
    himo <- pad_to_length(himo, group_size)

    full_line <- c(hc, lomo, himo)
    di[[paste0(i * 10, "%")]] <- full_line

    # Build the data frame from the list collected so far (rows = thresholds)
    formatted <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, di))
    rownames(formatted) <- names(di)

    out_path <- sprintf(glue("{project_dir}/Data/supp1 tables for prism/%s_2mm_FD.csv"), metric)
    dir.create(dirname(out_path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    write.csv(formatted, out_path, row.names = TRUE)
  }
}
```
